jobs.title: Junior Backend Developer
jobs.summary: I work on TaskATask, a task management platform built with Spring WebFlux and Neo4j. I built its real-time group chat with encrypted messages, a bulk contact import that handles up to 10,000 records, appointment notifications through Kafka with Google Calendar sync, and sign-in with Google, Facebook, Apple and one-time codes. I also tracked down and fixed a Neo4j performance bug that reloaded every relationship on each save. Before that, I built the booking and cancellation flows for Hospitalia, a doctor appointment app.
